summary: Implemented the public portal policy, privacy, consent, seller-readiness, third-party disclosure, safe-link, retention, and accessibility slice. Browsing remains available with an explicit readiness warning; account/submission consent and abuse-key persistence fail closed when their required migration or HMAC secret is absent. No production action was performed.
changes: Added bilingual public Privacy, Terms, and Cookie pages plus the footer Policies control and verified-identity presentation.

Added durable account and screenshot consent with prepared append-only migrations 0130 and 0131, policy versions, timestamps, locales, authenticated ownership, private screenshot access, and bounded retention.
Replaced raw portal abuse identifiers with secret-keyed HMAC keys that fail closed when the secret is absent or weak; stopped storing raw session IP/user-agent data.
Added explicit pre-request notices for Google Maps, Google Translate, and the configured AI provider; removed review/citation output and unsupported efficacy/authenticity claims.
Added seller publication-readiness fields without substituting the trade name, while preserving public catalogue browsing and gating AI/submission data collection.
Added safe external-link normalization at editor, frontend render, and public API boundaries.

Added public portal focus, contrast, alt-text, landmark, zoom, touch, truncation reveal, 375px brand wrapping, and document-scroll behavior; the catalogue keeps default page size 50 and exposes no page-size selector.
Added an exact root-owned English/Khmer language delta and a policy/readiness operations document.
